before.scope: Three actual updateCitizens intervals in a finite synthetic two-adult fixture. Both arms preserve the same initial matter; B differs only in willingness to help. Actual metabolism, fatigue, wear, task selection and paid gross transfers run. No macro weather update or living-world mutation. Reversed actor order is a separate paired control.

after.scope: Three actual updateCitizens intervals in a finite synthetic two-adult fixture. Both arms preserve the same initial matter; B differs only in willingness to help. Actual metabolism, fatigue, wear, task selection and paid gross transfers run. No macro weather update or living-world mutation. Reversed actor order is a separate paired control.

limits: The baseline is a current-law continuation of a copied historical inhabited save, with all earlier migrations. It is not a replay of the historical extinction law set.
Intake starts empty following its preceding migration and many inherited children are oversized. This is not a steady-state or calibrated population.
The two source variants have different subsequent choices and RNG trajectories. Aggregate differences are this whole-day counterfactual, not isolated causal shares or confidence intervals.
Funded body-work hours include limited transfers and abandoned work. Effective gathering effort, successful harvest, resource custody and actual oxidation are separate measures.
The lowest recorded child health is slightly lower after the change despite lower aggregate cold injury. Neither every individual benefit nor seasonal or generational viability is established.
Runtime timings are diagnostic durations with different concurrent host work, not a controlled speed benchmark or a live 1 GB inhabited-capacity test.
